post.topic: Automated Missed Call Follow-Up for Local Businesses
post.headline: Stop Losing Clients to Missed Calls
post.subline: Turn every unanswered call into a booked customer automatically with smart AI text-back systems.
post.caption:
Every missed call is a customer walking right over to your competitor.

When you are busy serving existing clients, picking up the phone isn't always possible. But leaving potential leads on voicemail often means losing the job entirely.

The fix is simple: an automated missed-call text-back system powered by AI.

The moment a call is missed, your system instantly sends a personalized text, answers basic questions, and provides a link to book an appointment.

Pro tip: Customize your automated text response to ask one simple question about their immediate need to kickstart the conversation.

DM "AUTOMATE" for a free 15-min call and let's set this up for your business.
post.insight_note: Local service businesses routinely lose high-intent leads simply because they cannot answer incoming phone calls while working with current clients.

reel.topic: Automating Wholesale Quote Requests and Stock Inquiries
reel.hook: Still answering bulk price inquiries manually daily?
steps: Connect WhatsApp to your live inventory spreadsheet
Set custom volume discount rules for AI
Automate instant quote replies for all buyers
reel.before: Hours spent drafting manual wholesale quotes
reel.after: Instant tiered pricing delivered via WhatsApp
reel.closing: Stop losing wholesale buyers to delays.
reel.insight_note: Wholesalers lose major orders due to delayed quote responses, making instant stock and pricing automation a high-ROI solution.
reel.caption:
Wholesalers, slow quotes are killing your bulk deals. When retail buyers message for stock levels or tiered pricing, waiting hours means they buy elsewhere. An AI assistant connected to your inventory sheet can instantly verify stock, calculate volume discounts, and deliver detailed quotes 24/7 on WhatsApp. Practical tip: Group your standard SKU pricing into a clean Google Sheet today so any automation tool can read it easily.
